reviews.title: Icebreakers need to go
reviews.text: I completely agree with the user below me about Icebreakers. One of the core issues with Skout and MeetMe is that there are message requests or “icebreakers”, which is unnecessary. Just allow open messaging like Tagged. Another major issue is like Moe said, the icebreakers are hidden off to the side. If you’re going to force message requests, at least make them more obvious. These apps clearly aren’t as popular as they used to be, you really can’t afford to have unnecessary barriers to messaging like this, but the app has been this way ever since the new UI launched almost 2 years ago, so maybe this is intentional on their part. There’s just common sense things that can be done to improve the apps that they simple refuse to implement.
